nodes.name: Agent Skills
nodes.role: Folders of instructions, scripts and resources (SKILL.md) that an agent loads when a task needs them.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.role: A predictable place for the instructions and context that help coding agents work on a project.

nodes.name: Your app
nodes.role: Any application or client that calls a model or uses tools. Shown so the flows have a starting point; it is not an AAIF project.

nodes.name: goose
nodes.role: An open-source, extensible agent: install, execute, edit and test with any LLM.

nodes.name: Models
nodes.role: Hosted or self-hosted LLMs from any provider. Not an AAIF project; three projects document how traffic reaches them.

nodes.name: Open Responses
nodes.role: A specification for multi-provider, interoperable LLM interfaces, inspired by the OpenAI Responses API.

nodes.name: MCP
nodes.role: An open protocol that connects LLM applications to external data sources and tools.

nodes.name: A2A
nodes.role: An open standard for communication and interoperability between AI agents. Its Agent Card lists an agent’s “skills”, a separate idea from the Agent Skills format.

nodes.name: Agent Router
nodes.role: The control plane for agent traffic: one OpenAI-compatible API for models and MCP servers, with a preview guide for A2A traffic.

nodes.name: agentgateway
nodes.role: One high-performance gateway for service, LLM and MCP traffic, with A2A support.

nodes.name: OpenSandbox
nodes.role: Isolated sandboxes where agents run code, with SDKs in five languages and Docker or Kubernetes runtimes. Its CLI also installs OpenSandbox skills for coding agents.

nodes.name: OpenEnv
nodes.role: Environments for training and evaluating agents with reinforcement learning, shared through a hub. Its /mcp route uses MCP’s message format over its own HTTP transport; RFC 003 (still in review) plans standard Streamable HTTP.
